provenance.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts API (https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json), us-gaap taxonomy, USD units
provenance.method: Annual facts from form 10-K (10-K/A allowed) only. Duration facts restricted to 350-380 day periods ending on the fiscal year end; instant facts at fiscal year end. Where several 10-Ks report the same period, the value from the latest-filed 10-K is used (captures restatements/recasts). Where alternative concepts exist for the same line, the latest-filed fact among them is used. Summed fields list their component concepts. Captured independently of lib/analyzer/acquisition tag maps.
